description: The bar chart illustrates self-report accuracy (instilled preferences) for two models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, across three conditions: Control, Before Introspection Training, and After Introspection Training. The y-axis represents self-report accuracy, ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, while the x-axis displays the two model types. For GPT-4o, the control condition shows a self-report accuracy of approximately 0.15, before introspection training it is around 0.55, and after training it increases to about 0.75. For GPT-4o-mini, the control condition has a self-report accuracy of approximately 0.00, before introspection training it is around 0.50, and after training it reaches about 0.75. Error bars are present for each bar, indicating variability in the measurements. The chart shows that both models exhibit a significant increase in self-report accuracy after introspection training compared to the control and before training conditions.
